transcript.content: Hello. What brings you in to see me today?

Well, I'm a construction manager, and lately, work has been... it's been getting really hard to keep on track. I can start a safety briefing or sit down for a plan review, and I'll be trying hard to pay attention. But within minutes, my mind is just off on three other job problems. I end up missing things I know I should have caught. It's causing real issues on the site.
Did you experience similar difficulties with attention and staying focused when you were a child or in school?

Yeah, I did. Even back in elementary school, my teachers were already telling my parents about it. They'd say I couldn't stay in my seat, and I talked out of turn a lot. I was constantly losing my homework, too. When we had assignments, I would just rush through the directions before I really even understood what I was supposed to do. So, yeah, it's been an issue for a long time.
Aside from the focus issues, have you been feeling persistently down, sad, or hopeless recently?

No, not really. I mean, I get pretty frustrated with myself when I mess things up on the job site, but I wouldn't say I feel sad or hopeless. My mood is mostly fine. It's really just this issue with my focus and keeping things straight that's driving me crazy.
Do you often find yourself dealing with excessive worry or feeling constantly on edge about everyday things?

No, I wouldn't say I do. I don't really have a lot of worry or feel on edge like that. Like I said, it's just the frustration of not being able to focus and making mistakes at work. But as far as just worrying about everyday stuff, no, that's not really a problem for me.
